next_error_contract: A failed downward APC request can leave a lower voltage applied. OPP current_opp and genpd performance_state stay at the prior point on callback failure. The next intermediate request can therefore be ordered as a downscale despite a physically lower clock/voltage. Regulator cached-request short-circuiting also needs consideration when restoring; regulator_sync_voltage can force reapplication but restore failure still needs a defined outcome.
